SELECT 
	TType = 'Sales',
	Date=P.Date,
	InvoiceCode='SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.SaleInvCode, 10))),
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	CustomerName=A.Name,
	NTN = S.NTNNo,
	NetAmount=P.InvTotal,
	ItemAlias = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	TaxCategory = TC.Name,
	AdvanceTaxPerc = TC.TaxPerc,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = P.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc = D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,
	SaleAmt = (SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax)),
	ItemAdvanceTax = ROUND((SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax)) * D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc * 0.01, 2)
FROM
	SaleLedger P, SaleDetail D, Accounts A, Customer S, Item I, TaxCategory TC
WHERE
	:ai_allcust=0 AND
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND
	P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	P.CustCode IN (:ai_Custcode) AND
	P.CustCode = S.CustCode AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	S.TaxCategoryCode = TC.TaxCategoryCode AND
	P.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	P.Date,
	P.SaleInvCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	S.NTNNo,
	P.InvTotal,
	P.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	TC.Name,
	TC.TaxPerc,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc
UNION ALL
